shared_elements: bird in profile with curved or hooked beak
linear hatching or repeated incised patterning
justification: The strongest correspondence is the use of profile birds with curved beaks, placed among other motifs on a vertical, tiered surface and rendered with linear outline/detailing. The biggest difference is that A is a symmetrical totem-like composition with large birds flanking or crowning a central anthropomorphic/crossed-limb form, while B is a crowded field of separate animal and sign motifs in horizontal bands with no matching central figure or paired-bird scheme.
